Usage: hiperf report [options]
       The default options are same as :
       -i perf.data --sort comm,pid,tid,dso,func
   --symbol-dir <dir>
       use symbols path to find symbols.
       separate the paths with commas.
   --limit-percent <number>
       only show heat percent limit content.
   -s / --call-stack
       show the unwind callstack
   --call-stack-limit-percent <number>
       only show the callstack heat percent limit content.
   --proto
       show protobuf content in the save file name.
       default file name is perf.data.
   --json
       report in json format.
       default file name is perf.data.
   --diff <target file>
       show the diff result from -i to -diff .
       example: "report -i a.data --diff b.data"
   --branch
       show the branch from address instead of ip address
   --<keys> <keyname1>[,keyname2][,...]
       select able keys: comms,pids,tids,dsos,funcs,from_dsos,from_funcs
           example: --comms hiperf
   --sort <key1>[,key2][,...]
       Choose some keywords.
       These keywords will be used for sorting.
       Only selected keywords will appear in the report.

           pid             -- process id
           tid             -- thread id
           comm            -- thread name (can be changed for same thread)
           dso             -- like dso name , or elf path
           func            -- function name in the symbols

       in branch mode:
           from_dso        -- branched from dso or elf
           from_func       -- branched from function
           dso             -- means branched to dso or elf
           func            -- means branched to function
   -i <filename>
           perf data file to report, default is perf.data
   -o <filename>
           report file name. if empty will use stdout print
   --hide_count
           will not show count in report
   --dumpoptions
           Dump command options.
